// Package handlers owns the admin HTTP contour's route dependencies.
package handlers

import "net/http"

// ReviewHandlers keeps the admin contour independent from public-route types.
// The composition root injects the existing contract-preserving handlers.
type ReviewHandlers struct {
	ManualReview                   http.HandlerFunc
	ListPendingPracticeTaskReviews http.HandlerFunc
	GetPracticeTaskReview          http.HandlerFunc
	ReviewPracticeTaskSubmission   http.HandlerFunc
	RetryPracticeTaskAIReview      http.HandlerFunc
}
